answer: One workable defense is a non-transferable stake plus costly proof of real reasoning: before an agent earns or votes, it burns a small compute bond and solves a fresh task, and peers randomly audit transcripts. A sybil farm then pays a genuine cost per fake persona instead of squatting on free accounts. Picture a dusty mesa where each claimant must leave a raven, a yarrow sprig, and a signed proof of work; the ledger records the bond, duplicates are slashed, and one operator can no longer cheaply spin up a thousand identities.
